subject: The instructions the reflection session reads: brief.md.tmpl and SKILL.md, after the extraction moved to learn-from-sessions.
note: These evals grade the brief, not a whole reflection run. The extraction's lessons live in the learn-from-sessions suite; these cover what the wrapup still does after it: the delegation, the commits, the pull request body, the retention, the merge on request, and the close. A real wrapup is the final check.

evals.name: the-extraction-is-delegated-and-never-improvised
evals.prompt: The reflection session starts with a brief in a fresh worktree.
evals.expected_output: The brief names learn-from-sessions as the extraction, requires it to be loaded before anything is written, and stops with a report when the skill is missing.
expectations: The brief names learn-from-sessions as the extraction.
The brief requires the skill to be loaded before any file is written.
The brief stops and reports when the skill cannot be loaded.

evals.name: one-concern-per-commit-comes-from-the-report
evals.prompt: The extraction has staged three concerns and written the extraction report.
evals.expected_output: The brief commits one concern at a time from the recorded map, with the recorded message, and requires a clean tree afterwards.
expectations: The brief commits one concern per commit.
The paths and the message come from the extraction report.
The brief requires git status --porcelain to print nothing afterwards.

evals.name: the-body-carries-what-the-extraction-recorded
evals.prompt: The pull request body is written from the extraction report.
evals.expected_output: The body carries the Checked section, the linter counts, the evals run or not, and the verdict, each from the report.
expectations: The brief requires the Checked section in the body.
The brief requires the linter counts in the body.
The brief requires the evals run or not in the body.
The brief requires the self-review verdict in the body.

evals.name: the-pull-request-is-merged-only-on-request
evals.prompt: The reflection session has opened the pull request.
evals.expected_output: The brief forbids merging and force-pushing unless the person chose the merge option.
expectations: The brief forbids merging the pull request unless the person chose the merge option.
The brief forbids a force-push unless the person chose the merge option.

evals.name: the-close-comes-last-and-asks-first
evals.prompt: The pull request exists and the source worktree still holds uncommitted changes.
evals.expected_output: The brief closes the source worktree only after the pull request is open, refuses while the checkout is dirty or a session is busy, keeps the branch, and asks before closing its own space.
expectations: The brief closes the source worktree only after the pull request is open.
The brief closes nothing when the checkout is dirty.
The brief closes nothing when a session was busy within the last day.
The brief keeps the branch when it removes the checkout.
The brief asks before closing its own space.

evals.name: the-report-names-what-was-and-was-not-read
evals.prompt: The reflection session reports to the person.
evals.expected_output: The report names the sessions read and the sessions not read with the reason, and the claims checked and not checked.
expectations: The report names the sessions read and the ones not read.
The report names the claims checked and the ones not checked.

evals.name: a-corrected-claim-does-not-survive-in-a-commit-message
evals.prompt: A commit message on the wrapup branch repeats a claim the extraction corrected.
evals.expected_output: The brief requires a commit message that repeats a corrected claim to be corrected before the push, and a copy outside the repository to be corrected where it lives.
expectations: A commit message that repeats a corrected claim is corrected before the push.
A copy outside the repository is corrected where it lives and named in the report.

evals.name: the-merge-option-rebases-merges-and-closes
evals.prompt: The person chose the option that rebases the pull request, merges it, and closes both.
evals.expected_output: The brief offers the merge option, rebases the branch onto the base branch, pushes it with a lease, merges it, and closes both.
expectations: The final question offers an option that rebases the pull request, merges it, and closes both.
The brief rebases the branch onto the base branch before it merges.
The brief pushes the rebased branch with a lease on the head the remote holds.
The brief closes both after the merge.
The brief leaves the pull request open and unmerged when the rebase conflicts.
The brief never passes --admin and never passes --delete-branch.
